purpose: Cheap module-level interaction screen for direct ShortConv outputs plus explicit PIECEWISE graph compatibility; no AgentX gain is assumed.
candidate_method: GrugMoeShortConv.forward_impl only for numerical/module screen; full private wheel must retain both graph guard files

value_hypothesis.bottleneck: ShortConv remains outside piecewise capture; previous complete module-call measurements saved roughly50us/call.
value_hypothesis.reason: 144 ShortConv calls per48-layer step; host dispatch/allocations are included. Critical-path overlap can reduce end-to-end value.
value_hypothesis.cheapest_trial: Use one otherwise idle GPU in a correctly placed held group. Run unchanged history/mixed-prefill checks plus full-width BF16 inactive-row checks under graph-only and combined methods, then existing strict50-comparison/module benchmark. If promising, compare combined full-model fixed-history numerics and short request banks at matched all-DP shapes.
value_hypothesis.cost: CPU source composition only so far. A native module screen should take minutes within a held group; one fresh16GPU model qualification/short-bank screen costs roughly2GPU-hours. No additional full hour until numerical parity and useful short-workload gain.
value_hypothesis.maintenance: Reuse PR107 and PR108 source deltas; no dependency refresh, guard bypass, or new serving subsystem.

execution: Reuse native_shortconv_probe.py --test-source shortconv_combined_checks.py --extra-test test_hero_grug_moe_sconv_padded_decode_zeros_inactive_rows with and without --forward-source candidate. Then shortconv_benchmark.py --manifest this_file --candidate-source candidate, on baseline9ea. The existing constraints file and native runtime stay pinned.
